opening.title: Product Designer
opening.summary: On a contract basis, design flows across the Nasfam Pay web and mobile apps, from research to shipped screens.
opening.about: Our customers move money in our apps every day. Good design makes that feel simple and safe. This contract covers specific flows from research and design through to working with engineers until they ship.
owns: Design for agreed product flows on web and mobile.
Prototypes and specifications engineers can build from.
responsibilities: Understand the problem with customers and data before designing.
Design within our existing visual system and extend it where needed.
Work with engineers through implementation and review the result.
requirements: A portfolio of shipped product work, with the reasoning behind it.
Strong interaction and visual design skills.
niceToHave: Experience designing financial or crypto products.
success: Agreed flows are designed, built and measurably easier to use.

questions.label: Walk us through one design decision you changed because of what you learned from users.
